definitions.explanation: A condition in which the concentration of glucose in the blood is abnormally high, often associated with diabetes.

examples.japanese: {高血糖|こうけっとう}は{糖尿病|とうにょうびょう}のサインだ。
examples.english: High blood sugar is a sign of diabetes.

examples.japanese: {食後|しょくご}の{高血糖|こうけっとう}を{抑|おさ}えるために{野菜|やさい}から{先|さき}に{食|た}べるとよい。
examples.english: To suppress high blood sugar after meals, it is good to eat vegetables first.

examples.japanese: {健康診断|けんこうしんだん}で{高血糖|こうけっとう}を{指摘|してき}されたので、{甘|あま}いものを{控|ひか}えるようにしている。
examples.english: I was told I had high blood sugar at my health checkup, so I'm trying to cut back on sweets.

notes:
A compound of {高|こう} (high) and {血糖|けっとう} (blood sugar). Frequently discussed in the context of {糖尿病|とうにょうびょう} (diabetes) and {生活習慣病|せいかつしゅうかんびょう} (lifestyle diseases), both major public health concerns in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高血糖|こうけっとう}{状態|じょうたい}: hyperglycemic state
- {食後|しょくご}{高血糖|こうけっとう}: postprandial hyperglycemia
- {高血糖|こうけっとう}を{改善|かいぜん}する: to improve high blood sugar
- {高血糖|こうけっとう}の{症状|しょうじょう}: symptoms of hyperglycemia

RELATED WORDS:
- {低血糖|ていけっとう}: low blood sugar (hypoglycemia) — the opposite condition
- {血糖値|けっとうち}: blood sugar level
- {糖尿病|とうにょうびょう}: diabetes
- {血圧|けつあつ}: blood pressure
